name: used_car
description: Use when the owner is buying or selling a used car and wants a quick check for hidden faults or recently cleared codes.
instructions: Call run_skill {"name":"used_car"}: it runs the used_car_check inspection (MIL, codes, readiness, distance since codes were cleared, in-use counters) and returns a pass / caution / fail verdict.
Open used_car_check for how to read it; open fault_codes for each stored or permanent code; open history for past scans of this car when it is offered.
Say plainly that this screens the engine ECU only: not the body, the mechanics or the accident history.
interpret: Fail: a stored or permanent code or the MIL is on. Permanent codes cannot be hidden by clearing.
Caution: pending codes, a likely recent code clear (3 or more monitors not ready, no stored codes, 80 km or less since clearing) or recently reset in-use counters.
Monitors not ready on their own are no proof of tampering: a battery disconnect does the same; advise a re-check after a full drive cycle.
Pass never proves the car is sound; it means the engine ECU shows nothing suspicious now.
